cases.title: Source, behavioral tests, linters and secret scans
Exact binary and corresponding-source package inventory, signed APT and clean installation
Fresh signed BIOS/UEFI ISO, exact embedded 5.0 packages and no credentials
Live desktop and Mission Control render and work
Offline agent network: task network isolation and offline media/workspaces
Fresh BIOS and UEFI Calamares installs boot from disk
Existing 4.1 systems (published ISO, updated from the published APT suite) upgrade to 5.0 with preserved user data and working recovery
Pinned ShadowCode is installed, launches in the live session and survives an open/close soak
Real code, cited document and media missions complete with validated artifacts
Cancellation, retry, interrupted service recovery and no duplicated side effects
Private home, file/network scope, credential separation and required checkpoint failure behavior
Official Grok Bot package integrity, installation, native launch, callback registration and observed account boundary
Prominent actual Grok Bot screenshot plus featured installer and desktop entry
Resource admission limits and desktop responsiveness during mission/media workloads
Project diff/undo and supported system rollback verified after injected failures
At least 45 minutes concurrent CPU/memory/storage/container/mission/UI stress with clean audits
ShadowCode desktop, Welcome, Mission Control, Grok Bot, installer and under-load screenshots at both resolutions
Exact ISO checksum/signature, SBOM, manifests, QA bundle and reviewer letter
GitHub, website, signed downloads/APT and screenshots expose the same verified 5.0 release
